frozen_inputs.fleet: inherit v1.5 exactly: three modeled fire brigades at B2/B3/B4

service_selection_rule: fixed before v1.6 outcomes as half / baseline / double the v1.5 modeled 90-minute service time; no empirical calibration claim

harm_rule.rationale: With deadline=120 min and severity in [2,5), K>=60 guarantees K*s^2 >= s*120 for every allowed severity s, so an unserved event is never scored below a served event solely because response occurred near the deadline.
harm_rule.note: K values are robustness surrogates, not empirically calibrated losses and do not affect dispatch decisions.

robustness_summary.negative_cell: mean paired deltaH < 0 and paired bootstrap 95% CI upper < 0
robustness_summary.positive_cell: mean paired deltaH > 0 and paired bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0
robustness_summary.service_robust_for_snapshot_load_k: all three fixed service times are negative cells for the same lambda
robustness_summary.global_service_robust_at_k: all six snapshot×load combinations are service-robust for the same lambda
robustness_summary.note: descriptive robustness labels only; no multiplicity-adjusted confirmation and no best-lambda claim

claim_scope: exploratory robustness of the v1.5 simulator; real frozen OSM/OSRM routing and archived AEMET hazard, but modeled fleet, arrivals, incident locations, severity, service-time scenarios, emissions and harm
